description: CTSM (CLM) boundary traces from an instrumented I-class CESM run (compset I2000Clm60Sp = 2000_DATM%GSWP3v1_CLM60%SP_SICE_SOCN_MOSART_DGLC%NOEVOLVE_SWAV). Default-gated by dump_clm=.false. and enabled in this run only. FIRST SLICE, prioritizing the urban (CLMU) / radiation / surface-energy path so the existing (unverified) EarthSciModels CLMU can be checked against real CESM: (a) D-boundary pointwise laws - the saturation specific humidity law QSat(T,p); the urban albedo law (UrbanAlbedo: per-surface reflected/absorbed solar + albedos); the urban longwave canyon law (UrbanRadiation/net_longwave: net+upward longwave per roof/road/wall); the urban canyon turbulent-transfer boundary (UrbanFluxes exit); the ground surface albedo (SurfaceAlbedo: soil/snow/ground albedo); the two-stream absorbed/reflected shortwave partition (SurfaceRadiation); the bare-ground turbulent-flux boundary (BareGroundFluxes); and the soil/surface energy-balance boundary (SoilFluxes). PET 0 only, first dump_first_cols points of each filter x first dump_first_steps steps, OMP-critical writes, EqIce-style CSV headers.

w2.indexing_bug: ROOT-CAUSED + FIXED (clm 2d8e0c697): gfortran passes whole arrays and associate names to assumed-shape dummies as 1-based POSITIONAL views, so a dummy declared (:,:) reads memory position j for dummy index j regardless of the actual's dim2 lower bound. The first W2 run therefore showed snow at j=4..12 (the true snow layers at memory -8..0 read via positions), garbage rows at j=-8..0 (OOB reads that coincidentally matched finidat slots 29..37), and W1 clm_soilfluxes t_soisno_1..3 = 0 (unused snow slots -11..-9 instead of the top soil layers). Fix: declare every 2-D dummy with an explicit dim2 lower bound -nlevsno+1 (positional correspondence then maps dummy index j to true memory j). Proven by a standalone gfortran reproducer (/scratch.local/ctessum/assoctest/t.f90) and by the regenerated CSVs matching finidat exactly: entry(step 1) T_SOISNO for c=1 and c=14 equals finidat_interp_dest.nc slots 4..37 to 34/34 layers (slot s <-> memory index s-12).
w2.header_order_defect: The first W2 clm_soiltemp '# columns' header listed qflx_snomelt_lyr,qflx_snofrz_lyr before h2osoi_liq,h2osoi_ice while the data emits h2osoi first (x(10)/x(11) before x(12)/x(13)); fixed in 2d8e0c697 (header reordered to match data; desc updated). Required one rebuild + rerun (LID 261102-004337).
w2.layer_convention: soiltemp rows use the MODEL layer index j: snow layers snl+1..0 (negative), soil layers 1..jbot (positive, jbot=nlevgrnd=25 here; nlevsno=12, levtot=37). The file/restart slot for layer j is j+nlevsno (proven via restart iodesc and finidat/restart T_SOISNO agreement). The earlier 'h2osoi NaN at step-1 entry' observation was a mislabel artifact of the header-order defect; with correct columns h2osoi is valid at every entry.
w2.snow_interstep: exit(step N) != entry(step N+1) for SNOW layers only (up to 4e-3 K, ~4% of snow pairs; columns 11-15 in this run) is designed model behavior, not a defect: between SoilTemperature calls, HydrologyNoDrainage adds snowfall to the top layer (UpdateState_AddNewSnow), Sublimation/evap on the top layer, DivideSnowLayers sheds the top layer's excess above snow_dzmax_u_1=0.02 m down the pack as a cascade (each layer sitting at its dzmax_u limit sheds a proportional slice into the layer below; mass-weighted Combo retemperatures the receiver - reproduced analytically to ~3%: predicted layer-7/8 gains +0.0219/+0.0462 kg/m2 vs traced +0.0225/+0.0477), and SnowCapping trims the excess above h2osno_max=10000 kg/m2 (10 m WE, this build's default) from the bottom snow layer. Deep snowpacks in this run sit exactly at both limits. Soil layers are continuous to 0.0 K.
w2.e_drop_note: gfortran es26.17 writes exponents <= -100 without the 'E' (e.g. '-1.23456789012345679-101'); verified this affects only header rows in these CSVs (no data row has an exponent <= -100), so no reformatting was needed.
w2.soilfluxes_w1_note: The W1 clm_soilfluxes t_soisno_1..3 values in the first W2-era runs (jobs 11971155 / 11967609 pre-fix LID 261102-001619) were affected by the same gfortran rebase (read 0 from unused snow slots -11..-9); from clm 2d8e0c697 + rerun LID 261102-004337 they are the top three soil-layer temperatures (model layers 1..3).
